Callout.Name: HGV Check - Mountain Pass
Callout.Message: Lorry stopped for a check, driver refusing to get out.
Callout.Advisory: Driver in the cab, engine running.

Script.Line: The load is legal and the paperwork is in the cab.
I am not getting out on ice. That is how people get killed.
Close the pass if you want. I am not moving.

Lines.Approach: The engine is running and nobody is getting out. There is ice on the pass.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
